subject: Re: Palisade Financial — SIG questionnaire & evidence orchestration
messages:
From: Maya Patel <security@palisade.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Desai <samir.desai@palisade.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Palisade SIG questionnaire — kickoff and evidence requests

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for agreeing to take our SIG questionnaire. Attached is the Palisade_SIG_2026.xlsx with sections we need mapped to your controls and artifacts. Key asks up front:

- Control mapping to SOC 2 (AICPA) and ISO 27001 clauses where applicable.
- Representative evidence for each control (policy, screenshot, exported logs, SOC 2 report sections).
- A timeline for delivery (we'd like the core mapping + artifacts within 10 business days).

We are particularly focused on IAM, key management, network segregation, and retention of audit logs. Please indicate any gaps or any artifacts that will be redacted/anonymized.

Also propose a 30–45 minute technical sync next week so our security engineering team can ask clarifying questions.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Security Lead, Palisade Financial
Attach: Palisade_SIG_2026.xlsx
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <security@palisade.com>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir.desai@palisade.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Palisade SIG questionnaire — kickoff and evidence requests

Hi Maya / Samir,

Thanks for the questionnaire — got it. We're happy to run through the SIG matrix and provide a mapped bundle. Quick plan from our side:

1) Initial mapping (controls -> Redwood control owner + SOC2/ISO mapping) — deliver by 2026-09-10.
2) Evidence bundle (sanitized artifacts and screenshots) — deliver by 2026-09-14.
3) Technical sync — propose Tue 2026-09-07 11:00 AM PT (I'll send a calendar invite).

Internal owners: Lauren Bishop will coordinate artifact collection and redaction; Karthik Iyer will gather IAM and logging extracts. I'll be your main contact for any scope clarifications.

Two clarifying questions for scope:
- Do you need full export of audit logs or sample extracts? We usually provide a timeboxed, sanitized sample for external reviews.
- For network segmentation evidence, do you prefer a high-level architecture + firewall rules, or raw security group configs?

Attached is a short cover letter that summarizes our attestation posture and the SOC 2 scope (redwood_rfi_cover_letter.pdf).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attach: redwood_rfi_cover_letter.pdf
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Maya Patel <security@palisade.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 09:27:00 -07:00

On Tue, Sep 1, 2026 at 10:03 AM Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the questionnaire — got it. We're happy to run through the SIG matrix and provide a mapped bundle.

Looping in a concise collection plan and checklist so we don't miss anything:

- IAM: policy documents, role-to-permission mapping, snapshot of admin roles (Karthik).
- Key Management: KMS configuration export + rotation schedule (Ops).
- Logging & Monitoring: sanitized audit_log_sample (last 30 days, redacted UIDs).
- Network: network_architecture_v2.png + example firewall/security group rules (redacted).
- Policies: Acceptable Use, Access Control, Change Management (PDFs).
- SOC: redwood's SOC 2 Type II summary (reference in cover letter).

Karthik — can you produce the IAM snapshot, audit log sample, and KMS export by EOD Fri 2026-09-03 so we can start assembling? I'll handle network diagrams and policy collection.

If Palisade prefers full exports, we'll need an executed DPA/DNDA — otherwise we'll only produce sanitized samples.

-L

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Trust & Safety (internal ops lead)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Maya Patel <security@palisade.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Palisade SIG questionnaire — kickoff and evidence requests

Folks — attaching the artifacts I captured during the collection window. Per the policy, these are sanitized samples:

- iam_policy_snapshot.txt (role mappings + admin roles exported from IAM admin console; usernames hashed)
- audit_log_sample_sanitized.csv (30-day window, UIDs replaced with stable pseudonyms)
- network_architecture_v2.png (high-level VPC diagram)
- kms_config_export.json (key metadata, rotation timestamps omitted where required)

Notes:
- Audit logs: we removed raw PII and replaced requestor IDs with pseudonyms; we kept timestamps and event types to demonstrate coverage.
- KMS: we cannot share raw key material; only metadata and key policy snapshots are included.

Linking a shared Drive for easier download: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3Redwood/PF-SIG-Exchange

If Palisade needs anything else (e.g., firewall rule examples), comment here and I will extract a redacted snippet.

-Karthik
Attach: iam_policy_snapshot.txt, audit_log_sample_sanitized.csv, network_architecture_v2.png, kms_config_export.json

Subject: Delivery: SIG mapping + evidence bundle (drive link & next steps)

Hi Maya / Samir,

Following up with the deliverables we discussed. Summary:

- Control mapping: Completed. We've mapped each SIG question to Redwood owners and indicated the corresponding SOC 2 control and ISO 27001 clause where applicable (see "Palisade_SIG_2026_mapped" in the Drive).
- Evidence bundle: Provided sanitized artifacts (iam_policy_snapshot.txt, audit_log_sample_sanitized.csv, network_architecture_v2.png, kms_config_export.json).
- Cover letter: redwood_rfi_cover_letter.pdf (scope and attestation references).

Download: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3Redwood/PF-SIG-Exchange
HubSpot ticket: HP-78923.

Two process notes:
1) Where artifacts contain customer-specific identifiers we redacted or pseudonymized them; if you require full, unredacted exports we can provide them after a signed DPA/fully-executed data-access agreement. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/Envelope12345
2) We included a short appendix in the mapping file noting a few control gaps (primarily around custom on-prem integrations for certain legacy connectors). Those are operational mitigations rather than accepted residual risks — happy to walk through in the technical sync.

Let's confirm the technical sync time — I'm proposing Thu 2026-09-16 10:00 AM PT. If that works I'll send invites and include our security engineer (Ops) to answer detailed KMS/logging questions.

Best,
Priyom Das
